<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 封面页 - 麦肯锡风格 (精装版) -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 顶部渐变条 -->
        <linearGradient id="headerGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#005587"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0076A8"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 装饰渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="decoGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#005587;stop-opacity:0.12"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0076A8;stop-opacity:0.04"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 白色背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- 左侧主装饰条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="12" height="720" fill="url(#headerGrad)"/>
    
    <!-- 左侧副装饰条 -->
    <rect x="12" y="0" width="3" height="720" fill="#F5A623"/>

    <!-- 左上角装饰组合 -->
    <rect x="60" y="55" width="180" height="5" fill="#005587"/>
    <rect x="60" y="65" width="100" height="3" fill="#0076A8" fill-opacity="0.5"/>
    
    <!-- 右侧大面积装饰区 -->
    <rect x="780" y="0" width="500" height="720" fill="url(#decoGrad)"/>
    
    <!-- 几何装饰元素 -->
    <rect x="850" y="120" width="360" height="360" fill="none" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.15"/>
    <rect x="900" y="170" width="260" height="260" fill="none" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.1"/>
    <rect x="950" y="220" width="160" height="160" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.03"/>
    
    <!-- 三角装饰 -->
    <path d="M 1050,140 L 1220,140 L 1135,320 Z" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.06"/>
    <path d="M 880,400 L 1000,400 L 940,520 Z" fill="#0076A8" fill-opacity="0.05"/>

    <!-- 主标题区域 -->
    <text x="60" y="260" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="56" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50" letter-spacing="-1">
        {{TITLE}}
    </text>
    <text x="60" y="330" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="56" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50" letter-spacing="-1">
        {{TITLE_LINE2}}
    </text>

    <!-- 副标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#5D6D7E" letter-spacing="0.5">
        {{SUBTITLE}}
    </text>

    <!-- 分隔线组合 -->
    <line x1="60" y1="450" x2="500" y2="450" stroke="#ECF0F1" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="60" y1="456" x2="200" y2="456" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- 项目信息区 -->
    <rect x="60" y="520" width="400" height="100" fill="#F8F9FA" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="60" y="520" width="4" height="100" fill="#005587" rx="2"/>
    
    <text x="84" y="555" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">PROJECT CODE</text>
    <text x="84" y="580" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">{{PROJECT_CODE}}</text>
    
    <line x1="260" y1="535" x2="260" y2="605" stroke="#ECF0F1" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <text x="284" y="555" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">DATE</text>
    <text x="284" y="580" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">{{DATE}}</text>

    <!-- 底部装饰线 -->
    <line x1="60" y1="680" x2="1220" y2="680" stroke="#ECF0F1" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- 机密标识 -->
    <rect x="1080" y="655" width="140" height="28" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.08" rx="4"/>
    <text x="1150" y="675" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587" letter-spacing="1">
        CONFIDENTIAL
    </text>

    <!-- 页码 -->
    <text x="60" y="700" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">{{PAGE_NUM}}</text>

</svg>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 封面页 - 麦肯锡风格 (精装版) -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 顶部渐变条 -->
        <linearGradient id="headerGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#005587"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0076A8"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 装饰渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="decoGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#005587;stop-opacity:0.12"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0076A8;stop-opacity:0.04"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 白色背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- 左侧主装饰条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="12" height="720" fill="url(#headerGrad)"/>
    
    <!-- 左侧副装饰条 -->
    <rect x="12" y="0" width="3" height="720" fill="#F5A623"/>

    <!-- 左上角装饰组合 -->
    <rect x="60" y="55" width="180" height="5" fill="#005587"/>
    <rect x="60" y="65" width="100" height="3" fill="#0076A8" fill-opacity="0.5"/>
    
    <!-- 右侧大面积装饰区 -->
    <rect x="780" y="0" width="500" height="720" fill="url(#decoGrad)"/>
    
    <!-- 几何装饰元素 -->
    <rect x="850" y="120" width="360" height="360" fill="none" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.15"/>
    <rect x="900" y="170" width="260" height="260" fill="none" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.1"/>
    <rect x="950" y="220" width="160" height="160" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.03"/>
    
    <!-- 三角装饰 -->
    <path d="M 1050,140 L 1220,140 L 1135,320 Z" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.06"/>
    <path d="M 880,400 L 1000,400 L 940,520 Z" fill="#0076A8" fill-opacity="0.05"/>

    <!-- 主标题区域 -->
    <text x="60" y="260" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="56" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50" letter-spacing="-1">
        {{TITLE}}
    </text>
    <text x="60" y="330" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="56" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50" letter-spacing="-1">
        {{TITLE_LINE2}}
    </text>

    <!-- 副标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#5D6D7E" letter-spacing="0.5">
        {{SUBTITLE}}
    </text>

    <!-- 分隔线组合 -->
    <line x1="60" y1="450" x2="500" y2="450" stroke="#ECF0F1" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="60" y1="456" x2="200" y2="456" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- 项目信息区 -->
    <rect x="60" y="520" width="400" height="100" fill="#F8F9FA" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="60" y="520" width="4" height="100" fill="#005587" rx="2"/>
    
    <text x="84" y="555" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">PROJECT CODE</text>
    <text x="84" y="580" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">{{PROJECT_CODE}}</text>
    
    <line x1="260" y1="535" x2="260" y2="605" stroke="#ECF0F1" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <text x="284" y="555" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">DATE</text>
    <text x="284" y="580" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">{{DATE}}</text>

    <!-- 底部装饰线 -->
    <line x1="60" y1="680" x2="1220" y2="680" stroke="#ECF0F1" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- 机密标识 -->
    <rect x="1080" y="655" width="140" height="28" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.08" rx="4"/>
    <text x="1150" y="675" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587" letter-spacing="1">
        CONFIDENTIAL
    </text>

    <!-- 页码 -->
    <text x="60" y="700" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">{{PAGE_NUM}}</text>

</svg>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 结束页 - 麦肯锡风格 (精装版) -->
    
    <defs>
        <linearGradient id="headerGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#005587"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0076A8"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="cardGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FAFBFC"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F1F3F4"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 白色背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- 顶部渐变装饰条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="6" fill="url(#headerGrad)"/>

    <!-- 背景装饰 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="720" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.02"/>
    <rect x="880" y="0" width="400" height="720" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.02"/>
    
    <!-- 几何装饰 -->
    <rect x="80" y="100" width="180" height="180" fill="none" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="120" y="140" width="100" height="100" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.03"/>
    
    <rect x="1020" y="420" width="180" height="180" fill="none" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="1060" y="460" width="100" height="100" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.03"/>

    <!-- 主感谢语 -->
    <text x="640" y="230" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587" letter-spacing="4">
        THANK YOU
    </text>
    
    <text x="640" y="300" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="52" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        {{THANK_YOU}}
    </text>

    <!-- 装饰分隔线 -->
    <line x1="480" y1="340" x2="600" y2="340" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="640" cy="340" r="8" fill="#F5A623"/>
    <line x1="680" y1="340" x2="800" y2="340" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 副标语 -->
    <text x="640" y="390" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#5D6D7E">
        {{TAGLINE}}
    </text>

    <!-- 联系信息卡片 -->
    <rect x="390" y="440" width="500" height="150" fill="url(#cardGrad)" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="390" y="440" width="6" height="150" fill="#005587" rx="3"/>
    
    <!-- 联系人信息 -->
    <text x="640" y="485" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        {{CONTACT_NAME}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="515" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">
        {{CONTACT_TITLE}}
    </text>
    
    <line x1="480" y1="535" x2="800" y2="535" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <text x="560" y="565" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#005587">📧 {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}</text>
    <text x="760" y="565" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#005587">📞 {{CONTACT_PHONE}}</text>

    <!-- 底部信息区 -->
    <rect x="0" y="640" width="1280" height="80" fill="#FAFBFC"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="640" x2="1280" y2="640" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- 版权信息 -->
    <text x="640" y="675" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#95A5A6">
        {{COPYRIGHT}}
    </text>

    <!-- 机密标识 -->
    <rect x="1080" y="655" width="140" height="28" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.08" rx="4"/>
    <text x="1150" y="675" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587" letter-spacing="1">
        CONFIDENTIAL
    </text>

    <!-- 页码 -->
    <text x="60" y="705" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">{{PAGE_NUM}}</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    水平条形图模板
    用途: 类别排名、数值对比（适合类别名称较长的场景）
    适用场景: 销售排行榜、品牌认知度、满意度评分
    支持: 8个条形（可调整为5-12个）
    与柱状图区别: 水平展示，更适合排名和类别名较长的数据
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 条形渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#42A5F5;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad2" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#66BB6A;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#FFB74D;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="hbarShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="1" dy="0"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.2"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>品牌认知度排行榜</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年消费者调研报告 · 样本量 N=5,000</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- X轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="300" y1="140" x2="300" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="480" y1="140" x2="480" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="660" y1="140" x2="660" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="840" y1="140" x2="840" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="1020" y1="140" x2="1020" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="1200" y1="140" x2="1200" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- X轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="300" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>0%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="480" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>20%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="660" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>40%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="840" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>60%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1020" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>80%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1200" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>100%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Y轴基线 -->
        <line x1="300" y1="140" x2="300" y2="620" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="300" y1="620" x2="1200" y2="620" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 条形数据 (条高36px, 间距24px, 总间距60px) -->
        
        <!-- 条形1: 品牌A - 92% (第1名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="175" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌A (市场领导者)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="155" width="828" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="1138" y="179" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>92%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形2: 品牌B - 78% (第2名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="235" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌B (新锐品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="215" width="702" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="1012" y="239" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>78%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形3: 品牌C - 65% (第3名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="295" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌C (经典品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="275" width="585" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="895" y="299" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>65%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形4: 品牌D - 52% (第4名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="355" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌D (区域品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="335" width="468" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="778" y="359" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>52%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形5: 品牌E - 45% (第5名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="415" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌E (性价比品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="395" width="405" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="715" y="419" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>45%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形6: 品牌F - 38% (第6名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="475" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌F (高端品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="455" width="342" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="652" y="479" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>38%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形7: 品牌G - 25% (第7名，橙色) -->
        <text x="290" y="535" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌G (新进入者)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="515" width="225" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="535" y="539" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>25%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形8: 其他 - 12% (第8名，橙色) -->
        <text x="290" y="595" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>其他品牌</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="575" width="108" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="418" y="599" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>12%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend">
        <rect x="60" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)"/>
        <text x="85" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>高认知度 (≥50%)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="240" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)"/>
        <text x="265" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>中等认知度 (30-50%)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="450" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)"/>
        <text x="475" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>低认知度 (<30%)</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 数据来源 -->
    <text x="1220" y="695" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="14" fill="#95A5A6" text-anchor="end">
        <tspan>数据来源: 市场研究部门</tspan>
    </text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    水平条形图模板
    用途: 类别排名、数值对比（适合类别名称较长的场景）

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    分组柱状图模板
    用途: 多系列数据对比
    适用场景: 多产品/时期/分类对比、同比环比分析
    支持: 4组 × 3系列（可调整为3-6组，2-4系列）
    与普通柱状图区别: 每个类别下有多个并排柱子，用于对比
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 系列1渐变（蓝色） -->
        <linearGradient id="groupGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 系列2渐变（绿色） -->
        <linearGradient id="groupGrad2" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 系列3渐变（橙色） -->
        <linearGradient id="groupGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F57C00;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="groupShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.25"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>各季度产品线销售对比</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年度 · 单位：百万元</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend" transform="translate(900, 70)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#groupGrad1)"/>
        <text x="30" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>产品线A</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="120" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#groupGrad2)"/>
        <text x="150" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>产品线B</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="240" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#groupGrad3)"/>
        <text x="270" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>产品线C</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- Y轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="570" x2="1180" y2="570" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="480" x2="1180" y2="480" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="390" x2="1180" y2="390" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="300" x2="1180" y2="300" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="210" x2="1180" y2="210" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- Y轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="125" y="575" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>0</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="485" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>50</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="395" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>100</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="305" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>150</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="215" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>200</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 坐标轴 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="165" x2="140" y2="570" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="570" x2="1180" y2="570" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 
        分组说明：
        - 4个组（Q1-Q4），每组3个柱子
        - 组宽度：240px，组间距：20px
        - 柱宽：60px，柱间距：10px
        - 每组起始：170, 430, 690, 950
        - 每50单位=90px高度
        -->
        
        <!-- Q1 组 -->
        <!-- Q1 产品线A: 120M (高度216px) -->
        <rect x="170" y="354" width="60" height="216" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad1)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="200" y="342" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>120</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q1 产品线B: 85M (高度153px) -->
        <rect x="240" y="417" width="60" height="153" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad2)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="270" y="405" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>85</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q1 产品线C: 65M (高度117px) -->
        <rect x="310" y="453" width="60" height="117" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad3)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="340" y="441" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>65</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q1 标签 -->
        <text x="255" y="600" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q1</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q2 组 -->
        <!-- Q2 产品线A: 145M (高度261px) -->
        <rect x="430" y="309" width="60" height="261" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad1)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="460" y="297" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>145</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q2 产品线B: 98M (高度176px) -->
        <rect x="500" y="394" width="60" height="176" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad2)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="530" y="382" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>98</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q2 产品线C: 78M (高度140px) -->
        <rect x="570" y="430" width="60" height="140" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad3)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="600" y="418" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>78</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q2 标签 -->
        <text x="515" y="600" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q2</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q3 组 -->
        <!-- Q3 产品线A: 168M (高度302px) -->
        <rect x="690" y="268" width="60" height="302" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad1)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="720" y="256" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>168</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q3 产品线B: 112M (高度202px) -->
        <rect x="760" y="368" width="60" height="202" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad2)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="790" y="356" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>112</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q3 产品线C: 92M (高度166px) -->
        <rect x="830" y="404" width="60" height="166" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad3)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="860" y="392" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>92</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q3 标签 -->
        <text x="775" y="600" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q3</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q4 组 -->
        <!-- Q4 产品线A: 185M (高度333px) -->
        <rect x="950" y="237" width="60" height="333" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad1)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="980" y="225" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>185</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q4 产品线B: 125M (高度225px) -->
        <rect x="1020" y="345" width="60" height="225" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad2)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="1050" y="333" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>125</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q4 产品线C: 108M (高度194px) -->
        <rect x="1090" y="376" width="60" height="194" rx="4" fill="url(#groupGrad3)" filter="url(#groupShadow)"/>
        <text x="1120" y="364" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>108</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Q4 标签 -->
        <text x="1035" y="600" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q4</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 趋势总结卡片 -->
    <g id="summaryCard">
        <rect x="60" y="630" width="400" height="60" rx="8" fill="#F8F9FA" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1"/>
        <text x="80" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>年度总计:</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="160" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2196F3">
            <tspan>618M</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="220" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>|</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="240" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#4CAF50">
            <tspan>420M</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="300" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>|</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="320" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#FF9800">
            <tspan>343M</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <text x="80" y="675" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="13" fill="#95A5A6">
            <tspan>同比增长: +15.2%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 数据来源 -->
    <text x="1220" y="695" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="14" fill="#95A5A6" text-anchor="end">
        <tspan>数据来源: 销售部门</tspan>
    </text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    分组柱状图模板
    用途: 多系列数据对比
    适用场景: 多产品/时期/分类对比、同比环比分析
    支持: 4组 × 3系列（可调整为3-6组，2-4系列）
    与普通柱状图区别: 每个类别下有多个并排柱子，用于对比
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 系列1渐变（蓝色） -->
        <linearGradient id="groupGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />

        <!-- 系列2渐变（绿色） -->

            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 系列3渐变（橙色） -->
        <linearGradient id="groupGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F57C00;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="groupShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>

    <!-- 背景 -->

    <!-- 标题 -->

          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>各季度产品线销售对比</tspan>

    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif"

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- Slide 06: Treatment Gap - Icon Infographic -->

    <defs>
        <linearGradient id="headerGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#005587"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0076A8"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <filter id="cardShadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="130%" height="130%">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="6"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="4" result="offsetBlur"/>
            <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08" result="shadowColor"/>
            <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>

    <!-- White background -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- Top gradient bar -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="5" fill="url(#headerGrad)"/>

    <!-- Header area -->
    <rect x="0" y="5" width="1280" height="75" fill="#FAFBFC"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="80" x2="1280" y2="80" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Section number badge -->
    <rect x="60" y="22" width="50" height="40" fill="#005587" rx="4"/>
    <text x="85" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">05</text>

    <!-- Page title -->
    <text x="130" y="52" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        Treatment Is Available but Often Lacking or Poor Quality
    </text>

    <!-- Section indicator -->
    <text x="1160" y="52" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">TREATMENT GAP</text>

    <!-- Key Insight Bar -->
    <rect x="60" y="100" width="1160" height="46" fill="#FFF8E1" stroke="#F5A623" stroke-width="1" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="60" y="100" width="5" height="46" fill="#F5A623" rx="2"/>
    <text x="85" y="128" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#E89207">KEY INSIGHT</text>
    <text x="210" y="128" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">Mental illnesses are treatable and their impact can be reduced — yet significant barriers persist in access, quality, and willingness to seek care.</text>

    <!-- 2x2 Grid of barrier cards -->
    <!-- Card 1: Stigma (top-left) -->
    <rect x="60" y="175" width="560" height="205" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8" filter="url(#cardShadow)"/>
    <rect x="60" y="175" width="6" height="205" fill="#E74C3C" rx="3"/>

    <!-- Icon -->
    <use data-icon="lock-closed" x="90" y="200" width="48" height="48" fill="#E74C3C"/>

    <text x="150" y="218" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#E74C3C">STIGMA</text>
    <text x="150" y="240" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#7F8C8D">Social & Cultural Barrier</text>

    <line x1="90" y1="255" x2="590" y2="255" stroke="#ECF0F1" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="90" y="280" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">Many people are uncomfortable disclosing</text>
    <text x="90" y="300" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">symptoms to healthcare professionals or even</text>
    <text x="90" y="320" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">to people they know.</text>

    <rect x="90" y="340" width="490" height="28" fill="#E74C3C" fill-opacity="0.08" rx="4"/>
    <text x="100" y="360" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#E74C3C">Result: Conditions go unreported and untreated</text>

    <!-- Card 2: Access (top-right) -->
    <rect x="660" y="175" width="560" height="205" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8" filter="url(#cardShadow)"/>
    <rect x="660" y="175" width="6" height="205" fill="#F5A623" rx="3"/>

    <!-- Icon -->
    <use data-icon="eye-slash" x="690" y="200" width="48" height="48" fill="#F5A623"/>

    <text x="750" y="218" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#F5A623">ACCESS</text>
    <text x="750" y="240" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#7F8C8D">Infrastructure Barrier</text>

    <line x1="690" y1="255" x2="1190" y2="255" stroke="#ECF0F1" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="690" y="280" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">Treatment is often lacking, especially in</text>
    <text x="690" y="300" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">low- and middle-income countries where</text>
    <text x="690" y="320" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">mental health infrastructure is minimal.</text>

    <rect x="690" y="340" width="490" height="28" fill="#F5A623" fill-opacity="0.08" rx="4"/>
    <text x="700" y="360" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#E89207">Result: Millions have no access to care</text>

    <!-- Card 3: Quality (bottom-left) -->
    <rect x="60" y="400" width="560" height="205" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8" filter="url(#cardShadow)"/>
    <rect x="60" y="400" width="6" height="205" fill="#005587" rx="3"/>

    <!-- Icon -->
    <use data-icon="triangle-exclamation" x="90" y="425" width="48" height="48" fill="#005587"/>

    <text x="150" y="443" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587">QUALITY</text>
    <text x="150" y="465" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#7F8C8D">Standards Barrier</text>

    <line x1="90" y1="480" x2="590" y2="480" stroke="#ECF0F1" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="90" y="505" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">Even where treatment exists, it may be of</text>
    <text x="90" y="525" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">poor quality — inadequate training, insufficient</text>
    <text x="90" y="545" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">dosage, or premature discharge.</text>

    <rect x="90" y="565" width="490" height="28" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.08" rx="4"/>
    <text x="100" y="585" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587">Result: Treatment received may not be effective</text>

    <!-- Card 4: Underreporting (bottom-right) -->
    <rect x="660" y="400" width="560" height="205" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8" filter="url(#cardShadow)"/>
    <rect x="660" y="400" width="6" height="205" fill="#00796B" rx="3"/>

    <!-- Icon -->
    <use data-icon="chart-bar" x="690" y="425" width="48" height="48" fill="#00796B"/>

    <text x="750" y="443" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#00796B">UNDERREPORTING</text>
    <text x="750" y="465" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#7F8C8D">Data Barrier</text>

    <line x1="690" y1="480" x2="1190" y2="480" stroke="#ECF0F1" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="690" y="505" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">Discomfort with disclosure makes it difficult</text>
    <text x="690" y="525" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">to estimate true prevalence — the actual burden</text>
    <text x="690" y="545" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#2C3E50">may be higher than reported figures suggest.</text>

    <rect x="690" y="565" width="490" height="28" fill="#00796B" fill-opacity="0.08" rx="4"/>
    <text x="700" y="585" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#00796B">Result: True burden is likely underestimated</text>

    <!-- Takeaway box -->
    <rect x="60" y="615" width="1160" height="44" fill="#F4F7FA" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="1" rx="6"/>
    <rect x="60" y="615" width="5" height="44" fill="#005587" rx="2"/>
    <text x="84" y="637" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587">TAKEAWAY</text>
    <text x="84" y="655" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#2C3E50">Good data is essential to understand these conditions — how, when, and why they occur, and how they can be treated effectively and safely.</text>

    <!-- Footer area -->
    <rect x="0" y="668" width="1280" height="52" fill="#FAFBFC"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="668" x2="1280" y2="668" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="60" y="695" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#95A5A6">Source: Our World in Data / IHME Global Burden of Disease (2025)</text>

    <!-- Page number -->
    <rect x="1140" y="680" width="80" height="30" fill="#005587" rx="4"/>
    <text x="1180" y="701" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">06</text>

</svg>

    <!-- Slide 08: Key Takeaways -->

    <defs>
        <linearGradient id="headerGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#005587"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0076A8"/>

    <!-- Section number badge -->
    <rect x="60" y="22" width="50" height="40" fill="#005587" rx="4"/>
    <text x="85" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">07</text>

    <!-- Page title -->
    <text x="130" y="52" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        Key Takeaways: Prioritizing Depression, Anxiety, and Closing the Treatment Gap
    </text>

    <!-- Section indicator -->
    <text x="1160" y="52" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">SUMMARY</text>

    <!-- Decorative left accent bar -->
    <rect x="60" y="100" width="5" height="540" fill="#005587" rx="2"/>

    <!-- Takeaway 1 -->
    <rect x="80" y="110" width="1140" height="88" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8" filter="url(#cardShadow)"/>
    <rect x="80" y="110" width="6" height="88" fill="#005587" rx="3"/>

    <use data-icon="circle-checkmark" x="105" y="126" width="32" height="32" fill="#005587"/>
    <rect x="105" y="164" width="28" height="22" fill="#005587" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="4"/>
    <text x="119" y="181" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587">1</text>

    <text x="150" y="142" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587">Depression and anxiety dominate the global mental health burden</text>
    <text x="150" y="166" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">Together they represent the overwhelming majority of mental health DALYs — approximately 80% of the total across</text>
    <text x="150" y="186" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">five major categories, each generating approximately 690 DALYs per 100,000 people.</text>

    <!-- Takeaway 2 -->
    <rect x="80" y="210" width="1140" height="88" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8" filter="url(#cardShadow)"/>
    <rect x="80" y="210" width="6" height="88" fill="#00796B" rx="3"/>

    <use data-icon="circle-checkmark" x="105" y="226" width="32" height="32" fill="#00796B"/>
    <rect x="105" y="264" width="28" height="22" fill="#00796B" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="4"/>
    <text x="119" y="281" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#00796B">2</text>

    <text x="150" y="242" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#00796B">Severe conditions carry disproportionate individual burden</text>
    <text x="150" y="266" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">Schizophrenia and bipolar disorder affect fewer people but create severe disability for individuals — schizophrenia</text>
    <text x="150" y="286" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">contributes 210.2 DALYs per 100K, reflecting its profound impact on daily functioning and long-term outcomes.</text>

    <!-- Takeaway 3 -->
    <rect x="80" y="310" width="1140" height="88" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8" filter="url(#cardShadow)"/>
    <rect x="80" y="310" width="6" height="88" fill="#E74C3C" rx="3"/>

    <use data-icon="circle-checkmark" x="105" y="326" width="32" height="32" fill="#E74C3C"/>
    <rect x="105" y="364" width="28" height="22" fill="#E74C3C" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="4"/>
    <text x="119" y="381" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#E74C3C">3</text>

    <text x="150" y="342" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#E74C3C">Treatment exists but access and quality remain inadequate</text>
    <text x="150" y="366" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">A large treatment gap persists — mental illnesses are treatable, yet barriers in access (especially in low-income</text>
    <text x="150" y="386" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">countries), quality of care, and willingness to seek help prevent effective intervention at scale.</text>

    <!-- Takeaway 4 -->
    <rect x="80" y="410" width="1140" height="88" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8" filter="url(#cardShadow)"/>
    <rect x="80" y="410" width="6" height="88" fill="#F5A623" rx="3"/>

    <use data-icon="circle-checkmark" x="105" y="426" width="32" height="32" fill="#F5A623"/>
    <rect x="105" y="464" width="28" height="22" fill="#F5A623" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="4"/>
    <text x="119" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#E89207">4</text>

    <text x="150" y="442" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#E89207">Stigma suppresses both help-seeking and accurate data</text>
    <text x="150" y="466" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">Discomfort with disclosure means true prevalence is likely underestimated. Stigma operates as both a barrier</text>
    <text x="150" y="486" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">to treatment and a distortion to the data that should guide policy decisions.</text>

    <!-- Takeaway 5 — Highlighted as primary recommendation -->
    <rect x="80" y="510" width="1140" height="100" fill="#005587" rx="8" filter="url(#cardShadow)"/>

    <use data-icon="circle-checkmark" x="105" y="528" width="32" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="105" y="568" width="28" height="22" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.2" rx="4"/>
    <text x="119" y="585" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">5</text>

    <text x="150" y="544" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Policy should prioritize scaling evidence-based interventions for common disorders</text>
    <text x="150" y="570" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.85">while maintaining specialized care for severe conditions. The greatest population-level impact comes from</text>
    <text x="150" y="590" font-family="Calibri, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.85">scaling treatment for depression and anxiety — but severe conditions must not be neglected in resource allocation.</text>

    <!-- Footer area -->
    <rect x="0" y="640" width="1280" height="80" fill="#FAFBFC"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="640" x2="1280" y2="640" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="60" y="675" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#95A5A6">Source: Our World in Data / IHME Global Burden of Disease (2025); Dattani, Rodes-Guirao, Ritchie & Roser (2023)</text>

    <!-- Page number -->
    <rect x="1140" y="655" width="80" height="30" fill="#005587" rx="4"/>
    <text x="1180" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">08</text>

</svg>

# 01_cover

Good morning. Today I want to walk you through the data on the global burden of mental illness — a topic that affects hundreds of millions of people worldwide, yet remains one of the most under-resourced areas in public health.

This presentation draws on the latest data from the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation, or IHME, and the Global Burden of Disease study, as presented by Our World in Data. All figures reference 2023 data.

Key points: (1) Mental illness is a leading cause of disability worldwide (2) The data reveals a striking pattern in which conditions carry the greatest burden (3) A persistent treatment gap demands policy action
Duration: 1 minute

---

# 02_prevalence

[Transition] Let's start with the sheer scale of the problem.

Depression is remarkably common. According to the data, 1 in 3 women and 1 in 5 men will experience major depression at some point in their lifetime. [Pause] These are not marginal numbers — this is a condition that touches nearly every family.

Mental health conditions span a wide spectrum. On one end, depression and anxiety are highly prevalent. On the other, conditions like schizophrenia and bipolar disorder affect fewer people but carry devastating individual consequences.

For policy planners, the message is clear: the scale of mental illness demands systemic responses — not piecemeal interventions. Lifetime prevalence this high means mental health must be integrated into universal health coverage.

Key points: (1) 1 in 3 women and 1 in 5 men face lifetime major depression (2) Conditions range from common to severe (3) Scale demands systemic policy response
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 03_burden_by_category

[Transition] Now let's look at which conditions carry the greatest disease burden, measured in DALYs — disability-adjusted life years per 100,000 people.

The data tells a clear story. [Data] Depressive disorders contribute 694.6 DALYs per 100,000, and anxiety disorders contribute 686.5. These two conditions tower over the rest. Schizophrenia comes in at 210.2, bipolar disorder at 94.6, and eating disorders at 47.5.

Critically, depression and anxiety together account for roughly 80% of the total mental health disease burden across these five categories. [Pause] This is the central finding: common mental disorders dominate the population-level burden.

Key points: (1) Depression and anxiety each generate ~690 DALYs per 100K (2) They account for ~80% of total mental health DALYs (3) All other categories combined represent only ~20%
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 04_depression_anxiety_parity

[Transition] I want to call out something striking: the near-equal burden of depression and anxiety.

The difference between them is only about 8 DALYs per 100,000 — essentially a statistical tie. This parity has important implications. It means that anxiety deserves the same level of policy attention and resource allocation as depression, which historically has received more focus.

Both conditions are common, both are treatable, and both are severely under-addressed in most health systems. Parity in burden must translate to parity in policy response.

Key points: (1) Only ~8 DALYs separate depression and anxiety (2) Together they dwarf all other categories (3) Equal burden demands equal policy resourcing
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 05_severe_conditions

[Transition] What about the less common but more severe conditions?

Schizophrenia contributes 210.2 DALYs per 100,000 — much lower than depression or anxiety in population terms, but the individual impact is profound. Schizophrenia involves severe, persistent disability that affects virtually every aspect of daily life.

Bipolar disorder, at 94.6 DALYs per 100,000, creates significant disability during episodes, even if the episodic nature means periods of relative functioning between crises.

The policy takeaway: while the greatest population-level impact comes from scaling treatment for common disorders, severe conditions must not be neglected. They require specialized, long-term care systems that many countries lack.

Key points: (1) Schizophrenia: 210.2 DALYs per 100K — severe individual disability (2) Bipolar: 94.6 DALYs per 100K — episodic but impactful (3) Lower population burden but high individual severity demands specialized care
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 06_treatment_gap

[Transition] This brings us to one of the most frustrating aspects of global mental health: the treatment gap.

Mental illnesses are treatable. Effective interventions exist. Yet four major barriers prevent people from receiving adequate care.

First, stigma — many people are uncomfortable disclosing symptoms to healthcare professionals or even to people they know. Second, access — treatment is often lacking, especially in low- and middle-income countries. Third, quality — even where treatment exists, it may be of poor quality. And fourth, underreporting — stigma and discomfort with disclosure make it difficult to estimate true prevalence, meaning the actual burden is likely higher than reported figures suggest.

[Pause] Good data is essential to understand these conditions and treat them effectively.

Key points: (1) Stigma suppresses disclosure and help-seeking (2) Access gaps are worst in low- and middle-income countries (3) Quality of care is often inadequate (4) Underreporting means true burden is underestimated
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 07_coping_strategies

[Transition] Given the treatment gap, how do people actually cope?

Global survey data reveals three dominant coping strategies. First, prescribed medication — common in higher-income settings where healthcare systems provide access to pharmacological treatment. Second, religious or spiritual activities — prevalent in many regions worldwide and often the primary coping mechanism where formal care is inaccessible. Third, talking to friends or family — a universally reported mechanism that requires no formal system.

The key insight here is diversity. Coping strategies are shaped by cultural, economic, and healthcare system factors. A one-size-fits-all policy approach will not work. Interventions must be culturally sensitive and account for local realities.

Key points: (1) Medication — evidence-based, common in higher-income settings (2) Spiritual practices — culturally embedded, primary mechanism in many regions (3) Social support — universally accessible but depends on community openness (4) Policy must be culturally sensitive
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 08_takeaways

[Transition] Let me close with five key takeaways for policy action.

First, depression and anxiety together represent the overwhelming majority of mental health DALYs — approximately 80% of the total burden across these categories.

Second, schizophrenia and bipolar disorder carry disproportionate individual burden despite lower prevalence — they require specialized, long-term care systems.

Third, treatment exists but access and quality remain inadequate — this is the core challenge we need to solve.

Fourth, stigma suppresses both help-seeking and accurate data — it distorts our understanding and blocks intervention.

And fifth — the primary recommendation — policy should prioritize scaling evidence-based interventions for common mental disorders, while maintaining specialized care for severe conditions. The greatest population-level impact comes from treating depression and anxiety at scale.

Thank you.

Key points: (1) Depression/anxiety = 80% of burden (2) Severe conditions need specialized care (3) Treatment gap is the core challenge (4) Stigma distorts data and blocks care (5) Scale interventions for common disorders while maintaining severe care
Duration: 2 minutes

Key points: (1) Schizophrenia: 210.2 DALYs per 100K — severe individual disability (2) Bipolar: 94.6 DALYs per 100K — episodic but impactful (3) Lower population burden but high individual severity demands specialized care
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 06_treatment_gap

[Transition] This brings us to one of the most frustrating aspects of global mental health: the treatment gap.

Mental illnesses are treatable. Effective interventions exist. Yet four major barriers prevent people from receiving adequate care.

First, stigma — many people are uncomfortable disclosing symptoms to healthcare professionals or even to people they know. Second, access — treatment is often lacking, especially in low- and middle-income countries. Third, quality — even where treatment exists, it may be of poor quality. And fourth, underreporting — stigma and discomfort with disclosure make it difficult to estimate true prevalence, meaning the actual burden is likely higher than reported figures suggest.

[Pause] Good data is essential to understand these conditions and treat them effectively.

Key points: (1) Stigma suppresses disclosure and help-seeking (2) Access gaps are worst in low- and middle-income countries (3) Quality of care is often inadequate (4) Underreporting means true burden is underestimated
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 07_coping_strategies

[Transition] Given the treatment gap, how do people actually cope?

Global survey data reveals three dominant coping strategies. First, prescribed medication — common in higher-income settings where healthcare systems provide access to pharmacological treatment. Second, religious or spiritual activities — prevalent in many regions worldwide and often the primary coping mechanism where formal care is inaccessible. Third, talking to friends or family — a universally reported mechanism that requires no formal system.

The key insight here is diversity. Coping strategies are shaped by cultural, economic, and healthcare system factors. A one-size-fits-all policy approach will not work. Interventions must be culturally sensitive and account for local realities.

Key points: (1) Medication — evidence-based, common in higher-income settings (2) Spiritual practices — culturally embedded, primary mechanism in many regions (3) Social support — universally accessible but depends on community openness (4) Policy must be culturally sensitive
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 08_takeaways

[Transition] Let me close with five key takeaways for policy action.

First, depression and anxiety together represent the overwhelming majority of mental health DALYs — approximately 80% of the total burden across these categories.

Second, schizophrenia and bipolar disorder carry disproportionate individual burden despite lower prevalence — they require specialized, long-term care systems.

Third, treatment exists but access and quality remain inadequate — this is the core challenge we need to solve.

Fourth, stigma suppresses both help-seeking and accurate data — it distorts our understanding and blocks intervention.

And fifth — the primary recommendation — policy should prioritize scaling evidence-based interventions for common mental disorders, while maintaining specialized care for severe conditions. The greatest population-level impact comes from treating depression and anxiety at scale.

Thank you.

Key points: (1) Depression/anxiety = 80% of burden (2) Severe conditions need specialized care (3) Treatment gap is the core challenge (4) Stigma distorts data and blocks care (5) Scale interventions for common disorders while maintaining severe care
Duration: 2 minutes
